newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Dorchester buys Civic Loan Finance.
newsitem.headline: Dorchester buys Civic Loan Finance.

text.p: Investment company Dorchester Pacific Ltd said on Friday it had purchased Dunedin-based Civic Land and Finance Limited for a total of NZ$2.6 million.

In a statement, Dorchester managing director Brent King said the deal would expand his group's network of financial services companies into the South Island, enhancing both the group's geographic spread and its earnings prospects.
Civic's business was in the area of personal financing, using mainly motor vehicles as security, King noted.
Total consideration for the deal was $1.25 million for the shares, and the refinancing of existing borrowings of approximately $1.35 million, Dorchester added.
